    About

    A small embroidery studio, one stitch at a time.

    tanyaa.creation makes hankies, hoodies, suits and hoop art, then embroiders each piece by hand. We keep orders small so every motif gets the time it needs.

    Choose a design from this page or bring your own idea. Before your piece ships, we send you a photo of it so you can see the finished work.

    Work
    Hand embroidery on cotton, fleece, linen and suit fabric
    Made to order
    Ready in 5 to 10 days, depending on the design
    Custom
    Names, initials, florals and your own motifs
    Payment
    UPI, with an advance for custom orders
    Delivery
    By courier, with a tracking link
